title: Red Soul Fire
description: Turns soul fire into a reddish-pink
body:
This resource pack makes soul fire reddish-pink. I sort of unconsciously based off of Terraria Calamity mod's Brimstone Crag colors.

----------------------------------------
This changes
- Soul Campfire
- Soul Torch
- Soul Lantern
- Soul Particle
- Soul Flame Particle

It doesn't change the biome fog, I tried, but I don't think you can change the fog color in a biome with only a resource pack.
